extensionDescription.message: Local ChatGPT long-conversation risk warnings and handoff help; no official quota, no chat upload.

riskAdviceNormal.message: This chat is in the lower-risk range.

riskAdviceLong.message: This chat is getting long. Consider organizing important context.

riskAdviceOrganize.message: This chat is nearing the risk range. Prepare to continue in a new chat.

riskAdviceHigh.message: This chat is in the high-risk range. Continue in a new chat soon.

riskAdviceHighConservative.message: This chat is in the high-risk range. The reference is conservative, so continue in a new chat soon.

statusUncalibratedHelp.message: To enable risk alerts, calibrate with a historical chat that reached the conversation-length limit.

statusCalibratingHelp.message: Reading the full chat. Keep this page open.

statusMeasurementUncertainHelp.message: This chat has not been read reliably yet. Use “More” to run a full read.

statusEnvironmentUnknownHelp.message: Measurement is temporarily unavailable. Risk assessment will resume automatically.

statusStaleHelp.message: The measurement method has changed. Recalibrate to resume risk alerts.

statusConservativeCalibration.message: Reference established. This chat includes content that cannot be measured precisely, so alerts will be more conservative.

statusGrowthLearning.message: Reference established. Learning chat growth; until enough samples are available, alerts trigger only at the historical reference.

actionCalibrateThisChatHelp.message: Only use a historical chat you know reached the conversation-length limit.

measurementScanIncomplete.message: Full read incomplete. Risk status was not updated. Keep the page open and try again.

measurementParserFailed.message: Some messages could not be read reliably. Risk status was not updated.

measurementScanSuccess.message: Full read complete. Risk status updated.

measurementConversationChanged.message: The chat changed during the read. Nothing was saved. Try again.

measurementGenerationChanged.message: The alert reference changed during the read. Try again.

measurementSampleUnusable.message: This chat cannot be read reliably right now. Risk status was not updated.

measurementScanFailed.message: Full read failed. Risk status was not updated.

passiveLimitHelp.message: Use this chat as a calibration sample only if you know this was the conversation-length limit.

consentLocalRead.message: Reads visible ChatGPT content locally to estimate long-chat risk.

consentNoRawPersist.message: Does not save raw chat text.

consentDeleteLocal.message: Uninstall or clear extension data to remove local data.

toastRecalibrationStarted.message: Recalibration started. Use a historical limit-hit chat to establish a new reference.

toastConversationMuted.message: Alerts turned off for this chat

calibrationNoConversation.message: Open a historical chat you know reached the conversation-length limit.

calibrationParserFailed.message: Some messages could not be read reliably. Calibration was not saved.

calibrationConservativeSuccess.message: Calibration complete. This chat includes content that cannot be measured precisely, so alerts will be more conservative.

calibrationConversationChanged.message: The chat changed during calibration. Nothing was saved. Try again.

calibrationGenerationChanged.message: The alert reference changed during calibration. Try again.

calibrationSampleUnusable.message: This chat cannot be read reliably and was not saved as a calibration sample.

toastScanFailed.message: Calibration did not finish. The alert reference was not updated.

scanNoScroll.message: Conversation area not found. Refresh and try again.

scanNoMessages.message: No chat content is available yet. Wait for the page to load and try again.

scanHeadLoading.message: Older history is still loading. Keep the page open and try again.

scanTailChanging.message: The chat is still updating. Wait for it to finish and try again.

scanAlignmentFailed.message: Part of the history could not be read continuously. Calibration stopped.

scanLimitReached.message: Full history could not be confirmed. Calibration was not saved.

scanIncomplete.message: Full history could not be confirmed. Calibration was not saved.
